fields.why: Insurance type (SES, 3 groups), age (5 groups) and race (4 named groups plus missing) each have DAA initiation measured per group and assessed by aORs against a referent (Table 2).
Insurance payor is SES under the brief; sex is 2 groups and Medicaid restriction status is a state policy, not an SPD.

Every reported contrast across these groups is an aOR with CI vs a Ref level (private; 50-59 yrs; White). The Wald chi-square of baseline characteristics by treatment status is named in Methods only; no result from it is reported, so it adds no omnibus entry.

brief_issues: Rule 6 says rule 2 governs whenever a test is reported across SPD levels, but does not say whether a test named only in Methods, with no reported result (here a Wald chi-square by treatment status), makes an omnibus entry.
